svg.title: Volcano Overall Architecture
svg.desc: Supported AI ecosystems distinguish frameworks and runtimes from workload orchestration, without implying fixed deployment dependencies. Ecosystem workloads integrate with Volcano through PodGroup. The Kubernetes cluster contains Volcano and compute nodes. Nodes contain CPU compute and accelerators, with extensible device access through device plugins and DRA drivers. Volcano provides job management, multi-tenant queues, resource utilization and topology-aware scheduling. HyperNode models network topology; NUMA is a separate topology dimension. HAMi provides integrated vGPU and vNPU sharing.
